defects.description: Detector flagged reclining (globalTilt missing) but description explicitly says Sit on the floor — this is a back-prop seated floor pose, NOT a reclining/lying pose. globalTilt would tilt whole body backward lifting legs off floor — incorrect.

Description says lean back on both forearms angled slightly BEHIND the hips. Baseline has shoulderFwdL:+7 (slight backward) and shoulderFwdR:-5 (slight forward); right arm reaches forward, not backward. Both wrists end up forward of hips (z=+0.078/+0.166) instead of behind. Elbows too bent (65/45) for forearms to extend down to floor.

failing_tests.assertion: both wrists z-coordinate should be <= 0 (behind body vertical axis) for forearms planted behind hips
globalTilt should be 0 for a seated-on-floor pose (description says Sit on the floor)

regression_risk: low — only arm fields changed; legs/torso unchanged; verified no anomalies/plausibility flags
rationale: Reclining flag is FALSE POSITIVE — description explicitly says Sit on the floor (seated floor pose with backward torso lean via spine:-18, NOT lying down). globalTilt would tilt whole body backward lifting legs off floor — incorrect. Real defect: arms forward instead of backward. Per actual renderer behavior (verified empirically via verify-patch.js), POSITIVE shoulderFwdL/R moves wrist BEHIND body when shoulder is in default abduction state (elbow at native x-side). Setting both shoulderFwdL/R to +30 produces wrists at z=-0.075 (L) and z=-0.121 (R) — both behind body, consistent with forearms planted behind hips. Elbows straightened (65/45 → 20) so forearms extend down toward floor. No anomalies or plausibility flags introduced.
